overall: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating outside a posted meeting by telephone and through a third party, and the chair individually violated it by emailing a quorum; the Board must disclose the emails.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly deliberated on a cable access contract by telephone with two other board members outside a posted meeting on February 7, 2013.
allegations.key_passage: Ms. Fox's telephone conversation with Mr. Sadeck alone constituted improper deliberation between or among a quorum of the Board because two members constitute a quorum.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly sent a follow-up email to board members on February 7, 2013, expressing opinions on the cable access matter before a LakeCAM meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Ms. Fox's follow-up email to the Board expressed policy positions and opinions on matters that were under active consideration by the Board.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly emailed board members on January 26, 2013, expressing her opinion on the cable access matter outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Additionally, Ms. Fox's January 26, 2013 email to the Board also constituted an improper deliberation because she expressed her opinion on a matter within the Board's jurisdiction.

allegations.summary: Chair allegedly had the town administrator poll board members by phone on closing Town Hall for a snowstorm, deliberating through a third party outside a meeting.
allegations.key_passage: A public body may not use a non-member, such as a staff member, to communicate on matters that the Board would otherwise save for discussion at an open meeting.

remedy: Disclose the content of the chair's January 26, 2013 and February 7, 2013 emails at a properly posted open meeting.
Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; future similar conduct may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board to disclose the content of Ms. Fox's January 26, 2013 and February 7, 2013 emails at a properly posted open meeting.
